source.citation: Takei et al. 2025, Preclinical Prediction of Resistance Mutations and Proposal of Sequential Treatment Strategies for ALK-positive Lung Cancer Using Next-generation ALK Inhibitors. Pharmaceutical Research
source.table: Table II: IC50s of Several ALK-TKIs in the Presence of Various Resistance Mutations (IC50, nM)
source.assay: Ba/F3 cells expressing EML4-ALK variant 1, cell viability assay; compound mutants carry G1202R or I1171N plus a second mutation

note: Source row label 'no mutation' is the native reference (WT). Zotizalkib, gilteritinib and neladalkib are reported for only a few rows and are not used (a variant is admitted only if every panel inhibitor is measured). Site = position of the second (added) mutation; background-only rows are keyed by their own position. Censored cells (>3000) are lower bounds (+1). Compound mutants were selected from Ba/F3 libraries by resistance to zotizalkib (G1202R background) or gilteritinib (I1171N background); the panel is therefore a resistance-enriched set.
